text: Implemented decomposition MVP in modules/multivar: JacobiSymmetricEigenSolver, GramSvdSolver over MatrixView, DenseGeneralizedEigenSolver, Svd/Pca/Plsc/Cca fitters, CrossProjection artifacts, ProjectionDiagnostics, and typed ComponentScale usage. Added deterministic oracle tests for diagonal eigensystems, rank-one SVD reconstruction, PCA, sparse-centered PCA preserving lazy preprocessing, PLSC cross-covariance, one-dimensional CCA, and generalized eigenvalues. Verified with sbt "multivarJVM/test" "multivarJS/test"; both passed 27 tests. Removed generated multivar target directories after verification; git diff --check passed for modules/multivar.
